note.question: How does decision-dependent travel time affect data-driven stochastic vehicle routing problems with deadlines?
note.overview: Vehicle routing problems (VRPs) with deadlines have received significant attention around the world. Motivated by a real-world food delivery problem, we assume that the travel time depends on the routing decisions, and we study a data-driven stochastic VRP with deadlines and endogenous uncertainty. We use the nonparametric approaches, including k-nearest neighbor (kNN) and kernel density estimation (KDE), to estimate the decision-dependent probability distribution of travel time.
